method: Each claim was independently checked on three lenses (evidence, value, feasibility). A claim survives when at least two of three verifiers did not refute it. note_on_fidelity: Each vote's refuted/confidence flags are verbatim. The verifiers' prose reasons and corrections are condensed here to their operative findings and directives; nothing was added, and no finding was dropped.
